provenance.method: Bounded review of MoneyHelper's current Budget planner and access notes; no financial outcome claim is made.

name: MoneyHelper Budget planner
description: Free MoneyHelper budgeting tool for putting income and outgoings in one place and seeing the resulting household picture.
intended_use: Structuring a budget when holding figures, bills and recurring costs in working memory is difficult.
audience_or_context: UK users who want a practical budgeting worksheet or tool; it is general money guidance rather than regulated personal financial advice.
limitations: A budget planner cannot decide what someone should cut, borrow, save or prioritise in a complex financial situation.
Figures are only as useful as the information entered and may need updating when income or bills change.
cost_or_access_notes: MoneyHelper describes the online Budget planner as free.
